div.div:
He has only three years left, his cultivation meridians sealed, bloodline hunted down, homeland torn apart, and his fate—to be devoured by the sparrow and python. Unable to train like ordinary cultivators do, he picks up a brush and rewrites his destiny.
(Source: MangaToon)

After transmigrating, Ye Xuan chanced upon the Devouring System. Not only could he devour everything, he could also exchange things for bloodlines, martial arts, divine weapons, medicinal pills, and all sorts of treasures… A ridiculously broken system! “Don’t you dare mess with me. Want to try me? I’ll swallow that precious divine sword of yours!” (Source: Bilibili, translated)

div.b: Your fortune: Good news will come to you by mail
